name: Slow
description: Level 3 Transmutation (Bard, Tidecaller, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: 120 feet Components: V, S, M (a drop of molasses) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot Cube within range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration. An affected target's Speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Agility saving throws, and it can't take Reactions. On its turns, it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the Attack action. If it casts a spell with a Somatic component, there is a 25 percent chance the spell fails as a result of the target making the spell's gestures too slowly. An affected target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
